home.seoTitle: About GDG on Campus Trakya University
home.seoP1: GDG on Campus Trakya University is the Google Developer Groups community active at Trakya University. We organize events, hackathons, workshops and learning programs for students and developers.
home.seoP2: As Google Developer Groups on Campus, we run regular activities around modern software development, AI, cloud computing and Google technologies for everyone who loves technology on campus.
